title: zsh_history
description: Exported by Interlinear 0.1.2 from zsh_history. Steps are chained only within each source file, in its line order; the files are parallel lanes, since nothing in them orders one against another. Each step cites its transcript lines and gloss sources.

steps.description: Line 1 (rule; operator): Collects operating system and hardware details.
Line 2 (rule; operator): Lists running processes, for example to spot security tools or competing malware.
Line 3 (rule; operator): Downloads a script and pipes it straight into a shell, so it runs without being saved.
